title: Fallback Telemetry Event
description: Canonical operational record for one cascade-layer attempt during document processing. Owned by US-166. The cu-cascade-handler skill (US-167) documents a richer internal emitter view; that view maps DOWN to this record at emit time. Where the two conflict, this schema is authoritative. PRIVACY (AC6): additionalProperties is false by design so that no filename, content, or extracted-text key can ever validate.

trace_id.description: UUID shared by every record emitted for a single user operation (one per layer attempt).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the layer attempt started.

handler.description: Handler category that produced this record. One of the fixed categories llm-native or pandoc, or a parameterised mcp-<name> / py-<lib>.

outcome.description: Result of this layer attempt. fallthrough means the layer declined or under-yielded and the cascade moved to the next layer.

latency_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of this layer attempt in milliseconds.

error_class.description: Error CATEGORY token (short snake_case, e.g. timeout, low_yield, unreachable). Populated when outcome is error or fallthrough; absent otherwise. The pattern is a privacy control (AC6): it rejects free-text values such as exception messages with embedded paths so no user content can validate or persist.

file_size_bytes.description: Size of the target document in bytes. The ONLY size/identity signal permitted; no filename is ever recorded (AC6).
